content: Melvin-Koushki says that in many instances it is impossible to tell whether a colophon date in MS Majlis 10196 is the date of composition or of transcription; fully half of the manuscript, representing almost two-thirds of the preserved works, was copied between 827-29/1425-27, the period bracketing Ibn Turka's first trip to Shāhrukh's court at Herat to defend himself against accusations of heresy.
